summary: ADT Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that three Apollo-designated directors resigned after Apollo sold all remaining shares via a secondary offering. Under an underwriting agreement dated May 4, 2026, Selling Stockholders (Apollo entities) sold 102,000,366 shares; concurrently, ADT repurchased 29,142,961 shares from underwriters under its existing $1.5 billion buyback plan. The offering and repurchase closed May 5, 2026. Bylaws were amended to remove Apollo-related references. No terms (price, premium, etc.) are stated in this excerpt. Watch for future capital allocation updates and potential ownership stabilization.
